approaches.name: Four-line boundary and Fermat deformation
approaches.outcome: Complete all-n negative answer to the unrestricted formulation, explicitly excluded from a claimed solution of the intended restricted problem.

approaches.name: Branch and deck-equivariant deformations
approaches.outcome: Proved equality of invariant tangent cohomology and logarithmic tangent cohomology of the branch pair; nontrivial characters remain uncontrolled.

approaches.name: Exceptional quadrangle character
approaches.outcome: Exact dimension-one n=3 character summand, recovering a credited published obstruction; no inference from this alone to local nonrigidity.

approaches.name: Uniform finite eigensheaf types
approaches.outcome: Proved eventual periodicity of infinitesimal-rigidity failure for each fixed arrangement. Actual fixed-sheaf cohomologies have not been evaluated in the intended generality.

approaches.name: Equisingular contraction bridge
approaches.outcome: Known singular-cover rigidity does not supply persistence and contraction of the exceptional curves under all abstract deformations; no proof of the missing bridge.
